prerequisites.name: BlueField DPU
prerequisites.definition: NVIDIA's programmable network card that runs its own operating system and offloads networking and security functions.
prerequisites.why: The policy decides how DPU hardware on a host gets treated.

prerequisites.name: DPU mode vs NIC mode
prerequisites.definition: A BlueField card can run as a full DPU with its own Arm OS or as a plain network interface card.
prerequisites.why: The Manage and Nic options correspond to these two operating modes.

prerequisites.name: Managed Host
prerequisites.definition: A bare-metal server under NICo's control, together with its DPUs.
prerequisites.why: The policy is set for each managed host.

prerequisites.name: PN/PSID
prerequisites.definition: A card's part number and its Parameter-Set ID, which identify the exact hardware SKU and its firmware flavour.
prerequisites.why: The device kind is derived from the part number.

prerequisites.name: DPU mode vs NIC mode
prerequisites.definition: A BlueField card can run as a full DPU with its own Arm OS or as a plain network interface card.
prerequisites.why: The device kind is defined as something that stays the same when the operating mode changes.

prerequisites.name: Baseboard Management Controller (BMC)
prerequisites.definition: A small embedded computer on a server's motherboard that allows remote management independent of the host OS.
prerequisites.why: BMCs are the thing being discovered.

prerequisites.name: DHCP
prerequisites.definition: A protocol that automatically assigns IP addresses to devices on a network.
prerequisites.why: Discovery is triggered when the BMC sends a DHCP request.

prerequisites.name: MAC address
prerequisites.definition: A hardware identifier assigned to a network interface.
prerequisites.why: The BMC is matched against the table by its MAC address.

prerequisites.name: Expected Machines Manifest
prerequisites.definition: A list the operator provides of the machines expected at a site, with their BMC MAC addresses and credentials.
prerequisites.why: Initial credentials are looked up in this table.

prerequisites.name: State machine (resource lifecycle)
prerequisites.definition: A model in which each resource is always in one defined state and moves between states through defined transitions.
prerequisites.why: Each tick is where state-machine transitions get executed.

prerequisites.name: Desired vs actual state reconciliation
prerequisites.definition: Repeatedly comparing the intended state with the observed state and acting to close the gap.
prerequisites.why: A tick is one pass of the reconciliation loop.

prerequisites.name: mTLS / gRPC
prerequisites.definition: gRPC is an RPC framework; mTLS is TLS in which both sides authenticate each other with certificates.
prerequisites.why: The definition contrasts a gRPC call that only sets a flag with the transition that happens on a tick.

prerequisites.name: Rack State Machine
prerequisites.definition: The lifecycle states NICo moves a rack through, such as Ready, Error, Maintenance and Validating.
prerequisites.why: The rack state machine picks up and runs the maintenance request.

prerequisites.name: State Controller Tick
prerequisites.definition: The periodic loop in which a state handler reloads an object and performs transitions.
prerequisites.why: The gRPC call only sets a request flag, and a later tick acts on it.

prerequisites.name: Maintenance Activities
prerequisites.definition: The ordered steps a maintenance run can include.
prerequisites.why: The request selects which activities to run.

prerequisites.name: Maintenance Scope
prerequisites.definition: The optional lists of device IDs to maintain.
prerequisites.why: The request specifies which devices to target.

prerequisites.name: GB200 NVL72 rack
prerequisites.definition: NVIDIA's rack-scale system made up of compute trays, NVLink switch trays and power shelves.
prerequisites.why: The scope lists machines, switches and power shelves within a rack.

prerequisites.name: Firmware inventory and update
prerequisites.definition: Listing the firmware versions installed on components and applying new firmware.
prerequisites.why: Firmware upgrade is one of the activities.

prerequisites.name: NVOS / NVUE
prerequisites.definition: The NVIDIA switch operating system and its configuration interface.
prerequisites.why: NVOS update is one of the activities.

prerequisites.name: NMX-C / Fabric Manager
prerequisites.definition: The controller that manages the NVLink fabric across switch trays.
prerequisites.why: NMX cluster configuration is one of the activities.

prerequisites.name: PowerSequence Reboot Barrier
prerequisites.definition: A coordinated rack power-cycle sequence that waits until all components come back.
prerequisites.why: Power sequence is one of the activities.

prerequisites.name: Rack Management Service (RMS)
prerequisites.definition: The service that carries out rack-level firmware and power operations.
prerequisites.why: SOT JSON is passed to RMS.

prerequisites.name: Rack profile
prerequisites.definition: A definition of a rack's expected components and their target configuration.
prerequisites.why: The SOT JSON can come from the rack profile's firmware object.

prerequisites.name: Firmware baseline enforcement
prerequisites.definition: Ensuring components run approved target firmware versions.
prerequisites.why: SOT JSON defines the target firmware configuration.

prerequisites.name: Client identity
prerequisites.definition: The authenticated identity of the caller making an API request.
prerequisites.why: Roles are assigned to authenticated identities.

prerequisites.name: BlueField DPU
prerequisites.definition: NVIDIA's programmable network card that runs its own operating system and offloads networking and security functions.
prerequisites.why: SuperNICs are BlueField-family cards.

prerequisites.name: Zero-trust host model
prerequisites.definition: The principle that the tenant's host OS is untrusted and must not be able to tamper with the infrastructure.
prerequisites.why: Lockdown exists to stop host tenants from tampering with the card.

prerequisites.name: Mellanox firmware tools (mlxconfig, mst)
prerequisites.definition: Tools for querying and changing NIC firmware configuration.
prerequisites.why: Lockdown blocks the configuration changes these tools make.

prerequisites.name: SuperNIC Lockdown
prerequisites.definition: A card mode that blocks firmware and configuration changes unless the card is unlocked with a key.
prerequisites.why: S-VPC is defined by NICo having to manage lockdown keys.

prerequisites.name: VPC (FNN VPC)
prerequisites.definition: A tenant's isolated virtual network in NICo.
prerequisites.why: S-VPC is a VPC deployment flavour.

prerequisites.name: Key Derivation Function (KDF)
prerequisites.definition: A function that deterministically produces keys from secret input material plus context.
prerequisites.why: HKDF is a specific KDF.

prerequisites.name: Input Key Material (IKM)
prerequisites.definition: The secret site-wide value from which keys are derived.
prerequisites.why: HKDF takes the IKM as its secret input.

prerequisites.name: KDF Context
prerequisites.definition: The non-secret inputs that tie a derived key to one card.
prerequisites.why: The info string is built from the context.

prerequisites.name: Key Derivation Function (KDF)
prerequisites.definition: A function that deterministically produces keys from secret input material plus context.
prerequisites.why: The IKM is the secret input to the KDF.

prerequisites.name: Credential store (Vault vs Postgres)
prerequisites.definition: Where NICo keeps secrets: in Vault or in encrypted form in Postgres.
prerequisites.why: The IKM is stored and versioned in the credential store.

prerequisites.name: Key Derivation Function (KDF)
prerequisites.definition: A function that deterministically produces keys from secret input material plus context.
prerequisites.why: The context is one of the KDF's inputs.

prerequisites.name: MAC address
prerequisites.definition: A hardware identifier assigned to a network interface.
prerequisites.why: The context includes the card's MAC address.

prerequisites.name: Machine ID
prerequisites.definition: NICo's stable identifier for a managed machine.
prerequisites.why: The context includes the host's MachineId.

prerequisites.name: Key Derivation Function (KDF)
prerequisites.definition: A function that deterministically produces keys from secret input material plus context.
prerequisites.why: The point is that a KDF adds no entropy to its input.

prerequisites.name: Input Key Material (IKM)
prerequisites.definition: The secret site-wide value from which keys are derived.
prerequisites.why: Rotation creates new IKM versions.

prerequisites.name: DPA Interface
prerequisites.definition: NICo's record and lifecycle for a SuperNIC attached to a host.
prerequisites.why: Cards move to the new version through the unlock/re-lock lifecycle.

prerequisites.name: SuperNIC Lockdown
prerequisites.definition: A card mode that blocks changes unless the card is unlocked with a key.
prerequisites.why: Moving to a new version means re-locking the card with a new key.

prerequisites.name: SuperNIC Lockdown
prerequisites.definition: A card mode that blocks changes unless the card is unlocked with a key.
prerequisites.why: The lifecycle includes the Unlocking and Locking states.

prerequisites.name: State machine (resource lifecycle)
prerequisites.definition: A model in which each resource is always in one defined state and moves between states through defined transitions.
prerequisites.why: The DPA interface moves through lifecycle states.

prerequisites.name: DPA (Data Path Accelerator)
prerequisites.definition: The programmable data-path processor on NVIDIA SuperNICs.
prerequisites.why: The record is named after the DPA-based SuperNIC.

prerequisites.name: BGP
prerequisites.definition: The routing protocol that exchanges reachability information between routers.
prerequisites.why: EVPN is carried over BGP.

prerequisites.name: Underlay and overlay networks
prerequisites.definition: The physical routed network versus the virtual tenant networks built on top of it.
prerequisites.why: EVPN is the control plane for an overlay.

prerequisites.name: VXLAN and VNI
prerequisites.definition: An encapsulation that carries L2 frames over an IP network, with each virtual network identified by a VNI.
prerequisites.why: EVPN tells VTEPs where addresses sit in a VXLAN overlay.

prerequisites.name: Underlay and HostInband network segments
prerequisites.definition: The kinds of network segments NICo manages on the physical fabric.
prerequisites.why: HostInband is one of these segment types.

prerequisites.name: Underlay and overlay networks
prerequisites.definition: The physical routed network versus the virtual tenant networks built on top of it.
prerequisites.why: It is defined as an underlay segment.

prerequisites.name: VPC (FNN VPC)
prerequisites.definition: A tenant's isolated virtual network in NICo.
prerequisites.why: A Flat VPC is a type of VPC.

prerequisites.name: HostInband Network Segment
prerequisites.definition: An underlay segment that a zero-DPU host's NIC attaches to directly.
prerequisites.why: It is the only segment type a Flat VPC accepts.

prerequisites.name: IP address pools
prerequisites.definition: Ranges of addresses NICo allocates from.
prerequisites.why: NICo allocates addresses for the VPC.

prerequisites.name: BlueField DPU
prerequisites.definition: NVIDIA's programmable network card that runs its own operating system and offloads networking and security functions.
prerequisites.why: DOCA is the software framework for BlueField DPUs.
